state_rules.rule:
eq < deviceA | ('buttonPressed' : false , ..) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceA 
= < deviceA | ('buttonPressed' : true , ..) > .

eq < deviceA | ('buttonPressed' : true , ..) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceA 
= < deviceA | ('buttonPressed' : true , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceA | ('buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : OldKey , ...) > $ UserX 'setKey' deviceA | (Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceA | ('buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ...) > $ deviceA 'sendBindingKey' cloudA | (Key) .

eq < cloudA | (deviceA : ('bindingKey' : OldKey , ..) , ...) > $ deviceA 'sendBindingKey' cloudA | (Key) 
= < cloudA | (deviceA : ('bindingKey' : Key , ..) , ...) > .

eq < deviceA | ('buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : Key , ..) > $ UserX 'getKey' deviceA 
= < deviceA | ('buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ..) > $ deviceA 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) .

eq < UserX | ('key' : OldKey , ..) > $ deviceA 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('bindingKey' : Key , ...) , 'owner' : nils , ....) > $ UserX 'bindDevice' cloudA | (deviceA ; Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('bindingKey' : Key , ...) , 'owner' : UserX , ....) > .

eq < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('bindingKey' : Key , ...) , 'owner' : UserX , ....) > $ UserX 'resetDevice' cloudA | (deviceA ; Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('bindingKey' : 'empty' , ...) , 'owner' : nils , ....) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceA , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : deviceA , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceA , ..) > .
